subject: Registrant de-duplication + ownership of post-event clips
messages:
From: Asha Kapoor <asha@eventco.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: registrant de-dupe + clip ownership question

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Quick context: our partner marketing team is running a joint webinar with Redwood on Nov 18. We have duplicate registrants across ON24 and Zoom (people registered for both entry routes) and legal wants clear ownership of post-event clips (who gets on-demand asset, watermarking, DRM if any). Can Redwood confirm:

- Recommended canonical source of truth for registrant (ON24 registration ID vs Zoom registrant email).
- If someone registers in both systems, do you dedupe at ingest or at export?
- Redwood's default clip ownership policy when a sponsor is present and when sponsor is not present.

Attaching our field mapping and current sample export for reference. Also looping in Samir (CDN partner) and ON24 ops for a quick sanity check on RTMP failover for recording continuity.

Thanks,
Asha Kapoor
Sr. Events Manager | EventCo
[Attachment: field_map.csv (CSV, 4 KB)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Asha Kapoor <asha@eventco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: registrant de-dupe + clip ownership question

Hi Asha — thanks for the note and the export. Quick answers up front, then proposed runbook steps below.

Short answers:
- Canonical registrant: email address + Redwood registrant_id (we surface registrant_id for ON24/Zoom ingests). We prefer to normalize on email for dedupe but keep both IDs attached for auditability.
- Dedupe timing: do it at ingest (our ingestion pipeline merges records on email, then attaches source IDs). This avoids duplicate invites and duplicate post-event emails.
- Clip ownership: default = Redwood provides the raw hosting file and a sponsor-specific clip if requested; ownership/licensing is defined by the SOW. For marketing micros (no sponsor), Redwood retains hosting rights but provides downloadable clip for EventCo. For sponsor-paid spots, we create a sponsor-deliverable clip and watermark per sponsor spec.

Proposed action items (we can run a 20-min sync tomorrow):
1) Field mapping confirmation (we reviewed field_map.csv) — action: Laura to mark any mismatches.
2) Ingest dedupe runbook: we will run a dry dedupe on a 1k sample to validate logic.
3) RTMP continuity test: Samir/ON24 to run a 30-min sim with planned encoder switchover; results to be uploaded.
4) Clip ownership addendum: Ben will draft 2 bullets to add to the event SOW for sponsor vs non-sponsor clip distribution.

I attached an internal runbook draft (runbook_v2.docx) that outlines the dedupe step and the scheduled test windows.

Jonas Weber
Sr. Events Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook_v2.docx (Word, 22 KB)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, Asha Kapoor <asha@eventco.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 13:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: registrant de-dupe + clip ownership question

Thanks Jonas — good plan. A few follow-ups from the product side:

- Conditional regform fields: for this event we added Sponsor Opt-in (checkbox) and Clip Release (radio: Yes / No). We need to map those into the normalization so we don't lose the consent flags when deduping (if a user checked Yes in Zoom but left it blank in ON24). Please ensure dedupe preserves the union of consent flags, not the first-seen value.
- Watermarking: sponsor requires visible lower-third for 10 seconds at start and end; can be burned-in at transcode or done as server-side overlay. Which do you prefer? Server overlay keeps master file clean.

I'm ok with the 20-min sync. Laura — can you confirm field_map.csv mismatches by EOD? Ben — can you draft the two SOW bullets for clip distribution + watermarking?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference

From: ON24 RTMP Ops <rtmp-ops@on24.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, Asha Kapoor <asha@eventco.com>
Cc: Samir Chaudhry <samir@cdnpartner.net>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: registrant de-dupe + clip ownership question

Hi team — ran the scheduled RTMP continuity sim this morning (attached results). High level: encoder switchover with SRT handshake to our ingest showed 98.7% frame continuity; we did see a 2.3s gap during the handoff in a worst-case config (older encoder). Recommendations:

- Pre-roll a 5s slate on switchover to mask gaps (simple and low-risk).
- Use server-side watermark overlay at transcode time — burning into the master increases rework for sponsor deliverables.
- We'll accept a signed clip ownership addendum via DocuSign (provide HubSpot SOW id).

Attaching the raw test log: rtmp-test-results-20261109.txt.

Regards,
ON24 RTMP Ops
[Attachment: rtmp-test-results-20261109.txt (TXT, 8 KB)]
